prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Assassin survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the exact approved single-facing shipped seed and locks this camera/facing. Image 2 is the four-view identity authority for costume/face details only; do not substitute any other facing from it. Preserve the same slim young adult man with tousled black hair, visible eyes, lower face covered by a high rust-red scarf, a single long torn rust-red cape, charcoal split tunic/trousers, layered dark bronze shoulder/forearm/knee armor, brown utility belt pouches, gloves and boots. ONE slender long brass-and-black carbine stays attached to the physical RIGHT hand at the rear trigger grip and LEFT hand under the fore-end. Keep both hands and the rigid weapon connected. Preserve cape/strap asymmetry and original layered shoulder shapes. No exposed mouth, hood, extra pistol, knife, second rifle or weapon swap. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet color planes and selective practical contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive tiny scratches, decorative filigree or noise. Maintain two arms, two legs and one intact body/weapon in every pose.
Every pose faces NORTH, away from the viewer. We see back of hair/coat/cape, never the face. Retain the exact original back-facing equipment placement. The gun is partly hidden naturally in front of the body, with its visible portion matching the seed. Preserve physical RIGHT trigger and LEFT support grip; do not mirror straps or belt.
Draw EXACTLY 4 full-body poses as one coherent idle sheet, arranged in one horizontal row of 4 complete poses on a wide transparent canvas. No additional figure. Action: A quiet planted breathing cycle: 1 upright ready pose matching the seed, 2 slight inhale through shoulders, 3 gentle weight settlement, 4 return toward pose 1. Boots stay planted and both hands retain the original lowered weapon grips. Only subtle cloth movement; no walk or shot.
Every pose is one complete independent drawn body at ONE common character scale calibrated from upright pose 1. Crouched and resting poses retain their naturally lower height. Use roomy clear gutters between all cells and generous padding around the ENTIRE body/weapon/cape, with a consistent ground baseline in each row. Genuine RGBA transparency: alpha zero outside each figure and between limbs/props. No floor, shadow, backdrop, haze, vignette, glow, particles, checker pattern, text, labels, frame numbers or grid lines. Keep a coherent animation rather than unrelated character illustrations.
